# GitHub Copilot Instructions

- Read [Common Instructions](../AGENTS.md) before analysis or editing.
- Read [Project Instructions](project-instructions.md) for repository and feature-specific rules.
- Evaluate changes against the common four-axis rules: Standardization, Commonization (Shared Reuse),
  Structuring, and Optimization. Report evidence and remaining gaps without unsupported percentages.
- Keep responses focused on outcomes, verification, and risks, in the user's language.
- This file is template-owned. Put repository-specific additions in `project-instructions.md`, not here.
